text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing, I stopped by
a high-end boutique with Gentildonna—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: My, that outfit suits you quite well.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Yes. After that, hold your chest high.
If you do that—you'll look a little more respectable.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In a few days, there will be a networking event connecting Umamusume with potential corporate sponsors and investors.
Today, we came to pick out an outfit for that occasion.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
High society is a battlefield where dignity and intellect clash.
Keep your wits sharp.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then came the day of the mixer.

text_block_list.name: Wealthy Person
text_block_list.text: "I hear plenty about your success. Sounds like you're working very hard indeed."

text_block_list.name: Businessperson
text_block_list.text:
"You must be Gentildonna-kun.
Your powerful performance and magnificent form have earned quite the reputation—truly worthy of the title 'Gentle Donna.'"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: My, what an honor.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After that... Once the greetings with the prospective sponsors were wrapped up, everyone chatted freely among themselves, but...

text_block_list.name: Businessperson
text_block_list.text:
You're in luck. You crossed paths with me.
From here on out, you will *always* win.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...What do you mean by that?

text_block_list.name: Businessperson
text_block_list.text:
We have plenty of funds, after all.
With state-of-the-art facilities and comprehensive support,
let us elevate you to even greater heights.

text_block_list.name: Businessperson
text_block_list.text:
I get to promote my company, and you get stronger.
Talk about a win-win, right? Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...I am sure there is no malice behind it, but that is rather a jarring way to put it.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: "A race is a venue for publicity, and the athletes are mere billboards... That must be how that person views it."

text_block_list.name: Businessperson
text_block_list.text: Aren't you happy to have a world-renowned corporation as our sponsor? Come on, let's make a toast!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Oh my.

text_block_list.name: Businessperson
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what nonsense.
What reason would I have to refuse?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Everyone has their own philosophy on racing. But if they lack respect for their opponent, cracks will form in the partnership eventually. Besides—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
choice_data_list: I cannot enter a contract with someone who cannot believe in that.

text_block_list.name: Businessperson
text_block_list.text:
I haven't the faintest idea what you mean.
A mere trainer has no business meddling—
choice_data_list: "I　C A N N O T"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"There is no need to linger here.
If you will excuse me, then."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...You are quite a straightforward person, aren't you?
Gentildonna's Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. And that sheer intensity...
Fufu, even the fur on my tail stood on end a little.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Good grief. What an absurd party that was.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
However... hohoho.
I did get to witness something quite intriguing.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Beneath a calm surface, great waves are often surging.
choice_data_list: To be honest, I was a little freaked out at first, though...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hesitated to voice my opinion to a world-renowned entrepreneur.
Even so—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
What a foolish question.
It's simply because I am "strong."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Hence, I have confidence. Confidence that
whatever calamity may befall me, I can brush it aside.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Standing beside 'the strongest' Umamusume—
that image alone gave me strength.
choice_data_list: Because I am your dedicated Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Your eyes have stopped wandering, haven't they?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"By the time we speak next,
rid yourself of that shifty-eyed habit."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Just like that pristine badge with not a scratch on it, you must be 'the brand-new one.'

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: She used to be moving around so restlessly before.
choice_data_list: Because it's not the "brand new one" anymore.
I'm still no match for you.
I'm still no match for you.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: She used to be moving around so restlessly before.
choice_data_list: Because it's not the "brand new one" anymore.
I'm still no match for you.
I'm still no match for you.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I like your spirit.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Still, never let your guard down.
Never, ever neglect your devotion to training.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"I see.
Then show me you can catch up."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"I look forward to seeing you
ascend to greater heights."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
My, how oblivious.
That simply will not do.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
The path to even greater "strength"
lies beyond self-awareness, after all.
